name: Stack
purpose: Arrange children in one tokenized row or column with logical spacing, alignment, wrapping, and responsive-friendly public props.
useWhen: Content needs one-dimensional vertical or horizontal layout.

avoidWhen.condition: Both rows and columns need explicit track control.

composition: Choose VStack for vertical flow or HStack for horizontal flow; set gap and alignment from the content relationship.

rules.statement: Use Stack for one primary layout axis and allow wrapping only when the resulting order remains clear.
Load styles.css or core.css plus stack.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Adding repeated custom flex utilities for ordinary rows and columns.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Stack so spacing and logical-direction behavior stay on the Brick contract.

validation: Check source and visual order at narrow widths and zoom.
Check gap, wrapping, alignment, and RTL behavior.
